title: Ioas round 3: less mud, softer s
intro: Round 3 starts from your round-2 pick, the de-resonance and dereverb chain, which you said was still muddy and had loud sibilants. The new versions cut the low-mid mud harder, move the presence lift lower so it stops feeding the s sounds, and add a de-esser that only turns down sibilant peaks. Six versions in random order: the original, your round-2 pick, and four new chains. All are matched in loudness.
